title: An AI diagnostic that scores a dental practice and books the sales call
summary: For a platform that grows dental practices with AI agents, we built the diagnostic that scans a practice online, scores it across 7 growth dimensions and books the call, plus a voice advisor and the onboarding pipeline that runs once a practice signs.
problem: The platform needed to show each dental practice, in minutes, exactly where it was losing patients, and turn that insight into a booked sales call. After signing, every new practice also had to be set up across listings, CRM, phone and an AI receptionist, which was slow and manual.
overview: A practice enters its website. Our pipeline reads it, scores it against local competitors, walks the owner through the results with an AI host, and has a voice advisor call with the practice's own report loaded in. Once they sign, onboarding runs on its own.

built.title: Website scraping
built.detail: A Make.com pipeline that reads a practice's website, with a fallback for Cloudflare-protected sites, and extracts structured data with Claude.

built.title: 7-dimension diagnostic
built.detail: A report scoring 7 growth dimensions using Google Places data, review scraping, ad detection and Google Maps competitor comparisons.

built.title: Report loading page
built.detail: A funnel page that waits for the report, then redirects, with an error alert when a site can't be read.

built.title: Live Results Room
built.detail: A funnel page with an AI host that walks the owner through their scan, powered by a Cloudflare Worker AI proxy.

built.title: Voice advisor
built.detail: A Vapi voice advisor that calls from the confirmation page with the practice's own data loaded in.

built.title: Listings onboarding
built.detail: New practices from Typeform become fully populated Yext locations with AI-written descriptions, logged back to GoHighLevel.

built.title: AI visibility reporting
built.detail: Monthly AI mentions, sentiment and citations across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, with weekly snapshots for trend history.

built.title: GoHighLevel setup
built.detail: Custom fields, ROI and booking calculations, email sequences and webinar watch-time tracking.

built.title: Real-time PMS sync
built.detail: NexHealth appointment events create, cancel or reschedule the matching GoHighLevel appointment within seconds.

built.title: AI receptionist onboarding
built.detail: A practice's Typeform submission sets up its AI receptionist and buys a local Twilio number automatically.

built.title: Webinar link builder
built.detail: Personal webinar schedule links and calendar invites, with descriptions written by GPT for each lead.

privacyNote: Practice names and contact details are blurred for privacy.
